localBackup.description: Use local JSON files to back up, move, or restore All API Hub data.
localBackup.title: Local backup and migration

title: Import/Export

autoSync.autosaveDescription: Sync strategy and the switch save automatically. The interval saves when you leave the field.
autoSync.enableDesc: When enabled, shared data will be synchronized to WebDAV at set intervals.
autoSync.intervalDesc: Set how often the automatic sync runs
autoSync.strategyDesc: Choose how data should be synchronized
autoSync.strategyLocalFirst: Local first - local data overrides remote data
autoSync.strategyMerge: Smart merge - merge local and remote data based on timestamps
autoSync.strategyRemoteFirst: Remote first - remote data overwrites local data
autoSync.title: Automatic sync

webdav.configDesc: Choose one cloud service to sync shared data. Connection credentials and device-local settings stay on this device.

connection.title: Connection settings
connection.webdavDescription: Enter the WebDAV address and credentials used by this device.

encryption.decryptDialogDesc: This WebDAV sync data is encrypted. Try a password to import it.
encryption.decryptPrompt: Cannot decrypt automatically. Please enter your password.
encryption.enableDesc: Optional: encrypt WebDAV backups with a password. If encryption is disabled, uploaded backups contain saved credentials in plaintext. Use encryption or store them securely.
encryption.passwordDesc: Used to encrypt uploaded cloud backups and decrypt downloaded backups.
encryption.sharedPasswordDescription: WebDAV and GitHub Gist share this encryption password. Switching services does not change it.
encryption.title: Data encryption

gist.autoSyncEnableDesc: When enabled, shared data will be synchronized to the Secret Gist at the selected interval.
gist.configDesc: Sync shared data through an encrypted GitHub Secret Gist. A Secret Gist is an unlisted link, not an access-control boundary.
gist.encryptionDescription: GitHub Gist sync requires an encryption password. The password is never uploaded to GitHub or included in backup files. If you lose it, the encrypted backup cannot be decrypted.
gist.encryptionPasswordRequired: Enter an encryption password before saving or syncing this Gist.
gist.idDesc: Optional. Leave empty to create a Gist automatically on the first upload.
gist.restorePolicyDescription: The active cloud provider syncs shared data, not a full device backup. Cloud credentials, encryption passwords, sync selection, and account auto-refresh settings stay on this device. Use manual export/import to migrate device-local settings.
gist.tokenDesc: Stored only in this browser; it is never written to backups or sent to All API Hub. Use a fine-grained token with only Gists read/write access, or a classic token with the gist scope.

manual.confirmDownloadDescription: Selected cloud data will be written to this device. Existing local data in those sections may be replaced; this action does not use Smart Merge.
manual.confirmUploadDescription: Selected local data will be written to the active cloud backup. Existing cloud data in those sections may be replaced; this action does not use Smart Merge.
manual.directionWarning: These actions are directional: upload writes selected local data to the cloud; restore writes selected cloud data to this device. They do not use Smart Merge.

provider.description: This selection controls both manual and automatic sync. Only one service is active at a time.
provider.label: Sync service

rebuildDialog.description: The cloud backup is incomplete. Continuing to sync could mix data incorrectly. You can create a new cloud backup from the data on this device.
rebuildDialog.fullSelectionNote: This rebuild will include all syncable data for this upload only. Your saved sync scope will not be changed.
rebuildDialog.title: Your cloud backup may be damaged
rebuildDialog.warningDescription: Rebuilding will replace the cloud backup with the current data on this device. If this device is missing accounts, bookmarks, or preferences, upload from another device with complete data or import a complete backup first.
rebuildDialog.warningTitle: Make sure this device has complete data

restorePolicy.description: WebDAV is meant for shared-data sync, not a full device backup. Your current device's WebDAV connection/encryption settings, sync selection, and account auto-refresh settings stay local and will not be uploaded to or overwritten from WebDAV. Use manual export/import when you need to migrate those device-local settings.

syncData.selectionRequired: Select at least one data domain to sync
syncData.title: Sync data
